scope: Whole supplied continuous battle: setup, all turns, terminal sequence and source ending
basis: Whole-source Sol review and coverage; separately commissioned bounded Sol checks of opening, ordinary turns/first moves, draws/searches, hands, both boards/Energy Zones, fans, decisive outcome; all frozen repairs independently verified. Root reconciled reports and inspected consequential boundary frames. Structure checked separately.
source_limits: Opponent draw/search identities are hidden and remain unnamed.
No full discard pile is opened or scrolled; top previews and visible KO transfers do not establish the whole pile.
No QR, deck list or deck selection is filmed in this source. Nearby-source QR is a candidate only; the unrecorded gap does not establish unchanged twenty cards.
Times are requested source-local seeks; decoded actual presentation timestamps were not measured. Input brackets are separate from card reveals/resolution.
No Auto control is visible in the reviewed source. Online opponent identity is visible, but ranked/casual queue is not filmed.
Selected board/hand frames often omit the Current turn label; those snapshots record null with a reason. Actual turns are established by alternating transition labels and final eight-turn screen.
external_status: Prepared for Pause Games; no new live deck or game save claimed. Missing matching current live list is preserved, filmed QR definitions prepared separately.
archive_authorization: Completed local review may be safely archived after verified CLI registration; original bytes/name preserved.
